services.name: School Tour Program
services.desc: Our school tours are inquiry based. Students look closely, talk about what they see, and make work in response. Each tour pairs an exhibition with a hands-on art activity, and is offered to students of all ages. Tours are $6 per student, run 1 hour 30 minutes, and accommodate up to 30 students. Each tour below opens with a question and lists what it offers different grade levels. To make a booking request, please click BOOK NOW on the relevant tour page below to access the booking form. services.desc: Centrally located in the heart of the Cultural District in downtown Kelowna, the Gallery offers a unique urban space that is perfect for small-to-medium sized gatherings. The floor to ceiling windows in The Front project space that face on to Water Street will add some WOW to your client appreciation, private reception, guest lecture, film screening, fundraiser, AGM, or other celebration. Holding your event at the Gallery also supports continued access to the visual arts in our community - thank you!
